ex.s: If I approach near to people, a hot terror seizes upon me, and I fear being exposed to the danger that my weakness might be noticed.
ex.t: 每当我靠近别人时，一股强烈的恐惧就会攫住我，我害怕自己的弱点可能会被发现。

ex.s: These days, audiovisual technology further exposes us to the wonder of the natural world.
ex.t: 如今，视听技术进一步让我们感受到了自然界的奇妙。

defs.def: the state of being in a place or situation where there is no protection from sth harmful or unpleasant 面临，遭受（危险或不快）

ex.s: Still, the findings show a potential path forward for reducing microplastic exposure — a task that’s becoming increasingly difficult.
ex.t: ·健康生活：赋予你在营养和情绪健康等领域做出健康决策的能力，引领健康的生活方式

ex.s: "To us, the most likely explanation appears to be that the basis lies in their living with humans, which gives them a lot of exposure to human facial expressions," and this exposure has provided them with many chances to learn to distinguish between them, Muller said.
ex.t: 区分形状                  B. 理解人类面部

ex.s: "Many people in China have limited exposure to English.
ex.t: "许多中国人接触英语的机会有限。

ex.s: According to an evolutionary psychology theory that a person's “life strategy” slows down or speeds up depending on his or her ___47___, exposure to a “harsh and unpredictable” environment leads to faster development, while a more resource-rich and secure environment has the ___48___ effect, the study said.
ex.t: 一个世纪前，当预期寿命较低且大学教育不那么普及时，"那时的目标是生存，而不是5岁开始学小提琴，"特温格说。

defs.def: the state of having the true facts about sb/sth told after they have been hidden because they are bad, immoral or illegal 揭露

ex.s: Exposure to high levels of radiation may increase the risks of contracting cancer and other diseases.
ex.t: 暴露在高水平的辐射中可能会增加患癌症和其他疾病的风险。

defs.def: the fact of being discussed or mentioned on television, in newspapers, etc. （在电视、报纸等上的）亮相，被报道
a medical condition caused by being out in very cold weather for too long without protection 挨冻；受寒

ex.s: Weston is no safer in the long run than outright exposure.
ex.t: 从长远来看，韦斯顿并不比完全暴露更安全。

ex.s: I’ll get more exposure to Chinese culture, too.
ex.t: 我也会更多地接触中国文化。

ex.s: First, we put on our spacesuits, which allow us to breathe in space and protect us from exposure to the cold and radiation.
ex.t: 首先，我们穿上太空服，它让我们能在太空中呼吸，并保护我们免受低温和辐射的侵扰。

defs.def: a length of film in a camera that is used to take a photograph （照一张照片的）软片，底片，胶片
the length of time for which light is allowed to reach the film when taking a photograph 曝光时间

ex.s: What’s more, my spacesuit keeps me safe from exposure to the Martian surface for up to several hours at a time.
ex.t: 更重要的是，我的太空服让我免受火星表面的辐射影响，每次可长达数小时。

defs.def: the act of showing sth that is usually hidden 暴露；显露
to make sth longer or larger 使伸长；扩大；扩展

ex.s: That effect extends beyond forests.
ex.t: 雪——已经受到气候变暖的威胁——随着温度升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变了它那种清冷的气味。

ex.s: To extend an invitation.
ex.t: 发出邀请。

ex.s: It extends the understanding of oneself.
ex.t: 关于《流动的盛宴》这本书我们知道什么？

ex.s: When my mother saw my creations, she told me how creative my designs were. ___34___ I learned a lot about how to extend the life of objects and transform them into something new and useful.
ex.t: 当母亲看到我的作品时，她说我的设计很有创意。___34___我学到了很多关于如何延长物品寿命并将其转化为崭新有用之物的知识。

ex.s: Policymakers should start thinking now about how to make sure the appearance of driverless vehicles doesn’t extend the worst aspects of the car-controlled transportation system we have today.
ex.t: 了解这些原因可以使我们审视自己的行为，纠正不良习惯。

defs.def: to make sth last longer 延长；使延期
to make a business, an idea, an influence, etc. cover more areas or operate in more places 扩大 … 的范围（或影响）

ex.s: The plan will extend protection to a significant number of areas that ___58___ (be)previously unprotected, bringing many of the existing protected areas for giant pandas under one authority ___59___ (increase)effectiveness and reduce inconsistencies in management.
ex.t: 该计划将把保护扩展到大量此前未受保护的区域，将许多现有的大熊猫保护区纳入统一管理___59___ (increase)有效性并减少管理上的不一致。

defs.def: to relate to or include sb/sth 适用于；包括

ex.s: For some days afterwards, groups of eyeing and pointing men stood about many a building, looking at long zig-zag cracks that extended from the roofs of buildings to the ground.
ex.t: 接下来的一些日子里，许多人成群结队地站在许多栋房屋前张望指点，看着从屋顶一直延伸到地面的那些弯弯曲曲的裂缝。

ex.s: Extending south from parts of what we now know as Mexico into Central America, __________________________________.
ex.t: 向南延伸，从我们现在所知的墨西哥部分地区一直到中美洲，__________________________________。

ex.s: It extended 4 ______________ and caused us to realise that the universe is a far larger place than we ever imagined.
ex.t: 它延伸了 4 ______________，让我们意识到宇宙远比我们想象的要大得多。

defs.def: to cover a particular area, distance or length of time 涉及（范围）；延伸（距离）；延续（时间）

ex.s: Learning to learn When you are extending or accepting an invitation, pay special attention to the following information:the date and time, what to bring, where to meet, etc.
ex.t: 学会学习 在你发出或接受邀请时，要特别注意以下信息：日期和时间、需要带什么、见面的地点等等。

ex.s: An extended metaphor refers to a comparison between two things that is developed at length over many lines of text, or throughout an entire work of literature.
ex.t: 延展隐喻是指将两个事物之间的比较，在文本的多行句子中，或贯穿整部文学作品进行长时间的发展。

defs.def: to make sth reach sth or stretch 使达到；使延伸
to stretch part of your body, especially an arm or a leg, away from yourself 伸展，舒展，展开（尤指手臂或腿）
to offer or give sth to sb 提供；给予
to make sb/sth use all their effort, abilities, supplies, etc. 使竭尽全力
the act of increasing the area of activity, group of people, etc. that is affected by sth 扩大；延伸

ex.s: Thus, the keyboard can determine people's identities, and by extension, whether they should be given access to the computer it's connected to—regardless of whether someone gets the password right.
ex.t: 因此，键盘可以确定人们的身份，进而判断是否应允许他们使用与其连接的电脑——无论某人是否输入了正确的密码。

defs.def: a new room or rooms that are added to a house 增加的房间
a new part that is added to a building 扩建部分；增建部分
an extra period of time allowed for sth 延期；延长期；放宽的期限
an extra telephone line connected to a central telephone in a house or to a switchboard in a large building. In a large building, each extension usually has its own number. 电话分机线；分机号码
the act of making sth longer or larger; the thing that is made longer and larger 延长；扩大；延长（或扩大）的事物

ex.s: The shelter, which could protect up to 8,000 people from wartime bombs, two large tunnels that were intended to one day become an extension of the London Underground.
ex.t: 这个最多可保护 8000 人免受战时炸弹袭击的避难所，包含了两个日后计划延伸成为伦敦地铁一部分的大型隧道。

defs.def: a part of a college or university that offers courses to students who are not studying full-time; a programme of study for these students （为非全日制学生开设的）进修部，进修课

ex.s: After taking extension courses for four years, Henry got his degree in history.
ex.t: 在修读了四年的扩展课程之后，亨利获得了历史学学位。

defs.def: the set of three letters that are placed after a dot at the end of the name of a file and that show what type of file it is 扩展名；（台）副档名
unexpected, surprising or strange 意想不到的；令人惊奇的；奇怪的

ex.s: Marie Curie(1869-1934) was a world-famous_________and was first awarded the Nobel Prize in 1903 for her extraordinary work in radioactivity.
ex.t: 玛丽·居里（1869-1934）是一位世界著名的_________，于 1903 年因其在放射性领域的非凡工作首次获得诺贝尔奖。

ex.s: It was an extraordinary experience and something I will never forget.
ex.t: 这是一次非同寻常的经历，我永远不会忘记。

ex.s: It truly is an extraordinary “Sky Railway”.
ex.t: 这确实是一条非同寻常的“天路”。

ex.s: With each person I met, I felt a growing sense of pride as part of this extraordinary team, whose devotion to the cause shone from their eyes.
ex.t: 我每见到一个团队成员，作为这支非凡团队中的一员，我都感到越来越强烈的自豪感，他们对该事业的奉献精神从他们的眼中闪耀出来。

defs.def: not normal or ordinary; greater or better than usual 不平常的；不一般的；非凡的；卓越的

ex.s: After all, the most extraordinary stories often happen in the most ordinary places.
ex.t: 毕竟，最非凡的故事往往发生在最平凡的地方。

defs.def: arranged for a special purpose and happening in addition to what normally or regularly happens 会议等
employed for a special purpose in addition to the usual staff 紧接名词之后
